_note: The authoritative list of concept ids. A concept is one idea a learner can know or not know. Lab lessons (labs/<slug>/learn/concepts/<id>.md), quiz questions and the onboarding quiz all refer to these ids, and `labs learn-check` fails on an id that is not listed here. Ids are `<area>.<name>`. `module` places the concept in a platform module so the onboarding quiz can summarise a learner per module.
